summary: 127 features and 13 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • preset-tasks: report server-decided hero in catalog (c8c8889)
  • frontend-config: add a separate mobile theme setting (c54f237)
  • sessions: store Codebuddy delivery notices as status notices (467b092)
  • codebuddy: report unsent chat images as a delivery notice (c90702d)
  • codebuddy: attach chat images inline in the CLI executor (7a251b2)
  • agent-cli: report image input support in settings (4958de6)
  • chat-images: prepare chat images for Pi, OMP and DSH (423962c)
  • copilot: steer running GitHub Copilot executions (e243909)
  • sessions: localize session user messages by AI language (1bc8205)
  • sessions: save tool-result images as assistant messages (c8cc366)
  • agent-cli: declare steering support in bundled presets (38dae4b)
  • session-messaging: expose scheduled send and cancellation APIs (a55f1fa)
  • orleans: dispatch scheduled messages when they become due (c1b73f8)
  • orleans: schedule chat messages for later delivery (9f4827a)
  • frontend-config: expose Yesterday’s Battle Report preferences (693fc88)
  • config: add the battle report presentation default (dea5c32)
  • demo-project: provision from the bundled MonoSpecs snapshot (95c2060)
  • skill-gallery: expose third-party audit ratings (f114ced)
  • messages: expose the parent tool-use id for subagents (deab866)
  • scheduled-plans: add confirmation for quota reset triggers (3b53679)
  • scheduled-plans: keep quota-reset conditions on gRPC (ccb5d03)
  • scheduled-plans: expose the last quota reset a plan triggered (f81eba6)
  • scheduled-plans: add Claude quota-reset triggers (6df556b)
  • git-config: seed profiles from the default Git identity (ddbb293)
  • silo-warmup: warm selected Orleans grains after startup (0266890)
  • token-monitor-history: persist and query monitor history (e101253)
  • token-monitor: forward HostHub limits and periods (e81752a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • mobile: show chat actions on the header of wider windows (93f89e7)
  • web: run card Super Commit headlessly when set to immediate (ee26f76)
  • web: show Git state in the project card’s second tier (23c3b79)
  • lib: share the question draft reducer with the phone (47f6bab)
  • i18n: add mobile strings for the new screens (4ff611a)
  • mobile: split proposal info into its own stage (f14fa4e)
  • mobile: show the default Hero in the server slot (4efaa21)
  • lib: flag code fences that are still open (c2939bd)
  • mobile: page older messages and size table columns (1ba2de3)
  • mobile: render visualizer and mermaid fences (bf347d2)
  • mobile: group the session list and show project avatars (1a6c8aa)
  • preset-task: run with the server-decided hero (023ef84)
  • lib: add collectStringValues to the draft image helpers (3103ec1)
  • mobile: add a read-only Usage tab for TokenMonitor (84096c3)
  • mobile: remember the last project on the new-session form (4851be5)
  • mobile: settle the picked summary in selection rows (89d24c2)
  • mobile: split scope rows into read and edit zones (72f296b)
  • mobile: tint tool glyphs and finished runs by kind (8ca1beb)
  • mobile: show each session’s cat, status ring and Hero badge (1f26eaa)
  • mobile: add the cat-head sprite sheet and its cell rules (97c24cf)
  • mobile: save the phone theme with a Follow system mode (13aa5b0)
  • mobile: add designed Light and Dark palettes (8c4ff2a)
  • i18n: add strings for the Usage tab and theme choice (e4683ba)
  • lib: order proposal repositories with the More group last (526822b)
  • lib: add the Hero id and icon to session summaries (751bf86)
  • lib: forward TokenMonitor pushes from the session hub (57224d3)
  • lib: add the TokenMonitor snapshot model and read (8a4eb25)
  • config: add the phone theme to the frontend config (d6b43b9)
  • mobile: show the proposal stage rail and repair notices (60d930f)
  • mobile: add the session info page with title edits and export (3069621)
  • mobile: add sort, select and bulk actions to the session list (4f6bd87)
  • i18n: add strings for session list, info and proposal rail (370dda8)
  • markdown: draw GFM task list checkboxes on the phone (76b7acf)
  • lib: add proposal stage rail, anomaly and name rules (78267c4)
  • lib: add session list rules for sort, manage, info and export (a73acfb)
  • mobile: add a composer tray and a queued messages page (26a27ff)
  • mobile: add image, phrase and send icons (a474241)
  • web: show DSH image input notice and patch how-to (25ecb1d)
  • mobile: refine the new-session and sessions screens for HagiTask (bc13196)
  • mobile: open chat images in a zoomable lightbox (221dc1b)
  • mobile: show one stage split button for the proposal stage (a0a4099)
  • mobile: pick a Hero from a shared selection page (4f1aa59)
  • web: gate Steer to executing runs and name the blocked reason (201ebff)
  • lib: show Pi, OMP and Codebuddy image hints on web and mobile (907fcef)
  • mobile: show the HagiCode mark in the top bar (6976ff9)
  • mobile: create HagiTasks with an optional Hero (b7b0f75)
  • mobile: return to the list on a leftward swipe (2ac43a0)
  • lib: add HagiTask catalog, creation and Hero helpers (a757cd1)
  • lib: send extra headers on gRPC-Web unary calls (d543b00)
  • mobile: nest subagent runs and fold task lists (b71f93a)
  • mobile: follow session updates live in the session list (5f26f79)
  • mobile: pick a Hero for each proposal action (51d2bc9)
  • mobile: add a shared component layer and tap sizes (da911c7)
  • mobile: add translations for the new mobile strings (e48b877)
  • web: close the phone info drawer on a leftward swipe (d15fd2b)
  • lib: feed session summary updates to one listener (fe7e057)
  • lib: add stage Hero selections to proposal details (42aebe7)
  • lib: read pipe tables in session Markdown (0157997)
  • lib: read tool result images, send modes and subagent parents (751c2f7)
  • mobile: start each chat in its remembered send mode (7498df7)
  • mobile: add proposal scope and favorites to new proposals (a0f9066)
  • lib: add the normal chat edit mode to settings (0aba942)
  • lib: add proposal scope, vaults, presets and favorites (f4d9654)
  • web: show agent images beside their tool call (510fee3)
  • mobile: match the desktop theme and tool-call display (d56caf6)
  • mobile: match the desktop transcript styling (9612b9b)
  • mobile: group tool calls across a turn in the transcript (c1af76d)
  • mobile: collapse thinking and tool blocks in the transcript (1b573c2)
  • mobile: render session answers as Markdown, hide empty system lines (5df39f9)
  • mobile: change the profile avatar (6bb26b4)
  • mobile: attach images to a message (57b33f7)
  • mobile: block-level notes in proposal review (b73efd8)
  • mobile: standard phrases in the composer (b295d0c)
  • mobile: read or edit mode for sending a message (1479da6)
  • mobile: optimize a proposal’s description (d3b4a8d)
  • mobile: proposal review of OpenSpec files (7d53f49)
  • mobile: share gRPC, SignalR and session models through @hagicode/lib (cda747e)
  • signalr: add scheduled message fields to hub wire (a5203e6)
  • settings: localize settings and apply the server language (f7a718e)
  • sessions: localize session screens and add scroll-aware FAB (83fc9e3)
  • shell: add bottom bar, rail and tablet layout (df038c8)
  • i18n: translate the app into ten server languages (939a184)
  • app: add sessions, proposals and settings to the shell (d1191f5)
  • sessions: show and send messages in a conversation (86af2db)
  • proposals: create proposals and show their detail (61d8589)
  • sessions: list server sessions with a type filter (fd62dea)
  • settings: read and edit the server profile and settings (6c5247e)
  • grpc: add gRPC-Web client and generated protobuf stubs (5e6ef0a)
  • app: wire scan, browser and sidebar into shell (58a1c9c)
  • drawer: add sidebar for scanning and saved pages (c2f8d86)
  • browser: show scanned pages in an in-app WebView (51a2bd3)
  • scan: add QR code scan screen for page links (f0291df)
  • ui: add shared theme tokens and app header bar (1edbd5a)
  • storage: keep up to ten recently opened pages (2b9149d)
  • scan: parse QR codes into page addresses (f5b9031)
  • theme: split family cards into light and dark halves (e402ce9)
  • theme: publish three background AVIFs for every family (d3f3b34)
  • theme: add catalog driven family browser (d18b2b9)
  • layout: show fullscreen toggle on desktop and mobile (2965c32)
  • preset-task: fit recent heroes to the available row width (44c7919)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hero-avatars: point catalog paths at nested web checkout (757d143)
  • sessions: cap session list at fifty after archive filtering (387b1a0)
  • frontend-config: validate themes against the frontend catalog (15f5fc2)
  • rpcgen: import API models from the maintained source directory (dca11af)
  • grpc-inventory: include retained web image routes (2d2e477)
  • scheduled-messages: retry dispatcher hint confirmation (7144fef)
  • git-watch: limit recursive watchers to Git metadata (0a1f9d3)
  • branding: centralize legacy logo fallback (071fa91)
  • prompts: handle missing prompt templates explicitly (4f007b5)
  • nullable: clarify optional values at backend boundaries (1b728cc)
  • git: guard missing failure details after rebase (489ce2c)
  • grpc: preserve null-valued business error metadata (55475e4)
  • claude: omit duplicate successful turn result text (afc8652)
